typography.installation: Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@400;600;800&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500&display=swap');

usage_rules.primary: Use for main actions (Search button, Subscribe), Brand headers.
usage_rules.accent: Use strictly for 'Price Drop' alerts, 'Lowest Price' badges, and high-urgency notifications.
usage_rules.background: Keep main surfaces pure white. Use subtle grey (#F8FAFC) for section differentiation.
usage_rules.gradients: Avoid gradients. Use solid, high-contrast colors.

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Main chart spans 2 cols, stats span 1.

buttons.style: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). High contrast. Hover: scale-105 transition-transform.

cards.style: Flat, bordered, no shadow (or very subtle).
cards.classes: bg-white border border-slate-100 rounded-2xl hover:border-slate-200 transition-colors

inputs.classes: h-14 rounded-xl border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#064E3B]/20 focus:border-[#064E3B] text-lg

charts.style: Minimalist. Remove grid lines. Use curveMonotone. Tooltip: Custom minimal style.

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-xl for floating elements (sticky nav).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 for sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: All buttons must have active:scale-95. Lists should stagger fade-in.

hero_background.usage: Use as a subtle background texture for the Hero section with low opacity (opacity-50) or blend mode.

placeholders.amazon_logo: Use text 'Amazon' or an icon from lucide-react/react-icons if image fails.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. SETUP THEME: Ensure tailwind.config.js uses the primary color #064E3B as 'primary'.
3. BUILD HERO: Create a centered, Google-style search hero but with the 'Manrope' font and the abstract background image.
4. CHARTS: Install 'recharts' (npm install recharts). Create a reusable <PriceChart /> component.
5. ALERTS: Use 'sonner' for all notifications (Price drop subscribed, etc.).
6. NO AUTH: Skip login screens. Direct user to Dashboard or Product Page.
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to the Search Input ('search-input'), Search Button ('search-button'), and Subscribe Form ('subscribe-form').
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Keep it flat and clean.
Use 2x more whitespace than you think is necessary.
Never center text in the 'Product Details' section; keep it left-aligned for readability.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL price numbers to convey data precision.
